language: Egyptian (Early and Classical Middle Egyptian), middle hieratic book hand; black ink with red rubrics. Transcription is Egyptological transliteration from the TLA corpus edition; translation is English (Leipzig papyrusebers.de, with documented exceptions).

regions.translation: Another remedy for the cardia: honey 1, balanites-oil 1, frankincense 1, wine 1, are mixed together, boiled and eaten.
regions.case_label: Eb 214, vgl. pChester Beatty VIII vso. 5,1-3

regions.text: k.t bj.t 2 qꜣw n mm 2 šnj-tꜣ 1 jri̯ m fqꜣ.w 4 r hrw 4 jr r-sꜣ psi̯ bj.t ẖr-ḥꜣ.t ḫr =tw ḏi̯.tw hꜣi̯ qꜣw n mm šnj-tꜣ wnm r hrw 4
regions.translation: “Another: honey 2, powder of ammi 2, colocynth 1, are shaped into 4 fḳ-cakes for 4 days. After the honey has first been boiled, the powder of ammi and colocynth should be added; is eaten for 4 days.”

regions.text: k.t n.t rʾ-jb sntr rʾ-64 pr.t-šnj 1/64 šnj-((tꜣ)) ḥsb bj.t ḥsb jrp 1/64 mrḥ.t ⸮ꜣpd? 1/64 psi̯ zwr r hrw 1
regions.translation: Another for the cardia: frankincense 1/2 ro, pignon 5 ro, colocynth 8 ro, honey 8 ro, wine 5 ro, goose-fat 5 ro, are boiled and taken for 1 day.

regions.text: k.t n.t dr mḥr.t jb qꜣw n bnj ḥsb ḏꜣr.t rʾ-32 ꜥmꜣ.w 1/64 ḥ(n)q.t nḏm.t 1/16 1/64 psi̯ ꜥtḫ zwr r hrw 4 thb.w r 1/32
regions.translation: “Another to expel illness of the stomach: powder of dates 8 ro, ḏrt 1 ro, ʿmw 5 ro, sweet beer 25 ro, are boiled, strained and taken for 4 days; inspissating to 10 ro.”

regions.text: k.t jrt.t ((1/64)) bj.t rʾ-16 mw 1/32 psi̯ ꜥtḫ zwr r hrw 4
regions.translation: Another: milk 5 ro, honey 2 ro, water 10 ro, are boiled, strained and taken for 4 days.

regions.text: pẖr.t n.t dr swš n tꜣ.w. PL ḥr ḥꜣ.tj jns.t 1 jšd rʾ-8 bj n sw.t rʾ-8 qmy.t rʾ-32 ḫꜣ. PL n.w šzp.t rʾ-32 qsn.tj rʾ-32 bj.t ḥsb mw 1/16 sḏr n jꜣd.t swrj r hrw 4
regions.translation: Remedy to expel heat-rotation (footnote: This peculiar term has probably been chosen, because the state is compared to the development of heat by rotation of a fire-drill.) in the heart: nśt 1, sebesten 4 ro, bj of wheat 4 ro, gum 1 ro, leaves of cucumber 1 ro, ḳśntj 1 ro, honey 8 ro, water 20 ro, remains during the night in the dew and is drunk for 4 days.

regions.text: k.t 〈n.t〉 srwḫ ḥꜣ.tj šzp.t rʾ-32 nqꜥ.wt 1/64 stj rʾ-32 bnj wꜣḏ 1/64 bj.t 1/64 mw 1/32 sḏr n jꜣd.t ꜥtḫ zwr r hrw 1 (vacat: Rest der Zeile freigelassen)
regions.translation: Another to treat the heart: cucumber 1 ro, sycamore-fruit 5 ro, yellow ochre 1 ro, fresh dates 5 ro, honey 5 ro, water 20 ro, remains during the night in the dew, is strained and taken for 1 day.

regions.text: ḥꜣ.t-ꜥ m pẖr.t n.t dr ꜥꜣꜥ m ẖ.t m ḥꜣ.tj pr.t šꜣms rʾ-16 šꜣšꜣ rʾ-8 ztj rʾ-64 bj.t ⸮sfḫ? gs jri̯ m (j)ḫ.t wꜥ.t wnm dp-ꜥ sḏr
regions.translation: Beginning of remedies to expel hæmaturia in the belly and in the heart: fruit of šmś 2 ro, šš 4 ro, yellow ochre 1/2 ro, honey 1/6 hin (?), are mixed together and eaten before going to bed.

regions.text: k.t gw rʾ-8 šꜣšꜣ rʾ-8 pr.t-šnj rʾ-16 wꜣḏ.w rʾ-64 shr.t rʾ-32 psd rʾ-32 bj.t ⸮sfḫ? gs jri̯ m (j)ḫ.t wꜥ.t wnm dp-ꜥ sḏr
regions.translation: Another: rush-nut 4 ro, šš 4 ro, pignon 2 ro, malachite 1/2 ro, śhrt 1 ro, hyoscyamus 1 ro, honey 1/6 hin (?), are mixed together and eaten before going to bed.

regions.text: k.t qmy.t rʾ-32 jꜣrr(.wt) rʾ-16 šꜣšꜣ rʾ-8 šꜣms rʾ-16 bj.t ⸮sfḫ? gs jri̯ m (j)ḫ.t wꜥ.t wnm dp-ꜥ sḏr
regions.translation: Another: gum 1 ro, grapes 2 ro, šš 4 ro, šmś 2 ro, honey 1/6 hin (?), are mixed together and eaten before going to bed.

regions.text: k.t pẖr.t wꜥḥ nḏ 1/64 ḥm.w. PL n.w kꜣkꜣ rʾ-8 ḫs(ꜣ).w. PL n nh.t rʾ-8 bnj wꜣḏ rʾ-8 ḫꜣ. PL sšn rʾ-8 ꜣḥ wꜣḏ 1/32 mw 1/16 ꜥtḫ zwr ḥr-ꜥ(.wj)
regions.translation: Another remedy: ground manna 5 ro, ḥmw of kk 4 ro, ḫsw of sycamore 4 ro, fresh dates 4 ro, leaves of lotus 4 ro, fresh porridge 10 ro, water 20 ro, are strained and taken immediately.

regions.text: k.t n.t dr ꜥꜣꜥ n nṯr n m(w)t m ẖ.t n.t s ḏrḏ n šnd.t rʾ-32 ḏrḏ n ꜥr.w rʾ-32 qꜣꜣ. PL n ꜥr.w rʾ-32 ḏꜣr.t rʾ-8 ḥmꜣ.t rʾ-32 jꜣrr(.wt) rʾ-8 jm.j n wḏꜥ.yt rʾ-32 šꜣšꜣ rʾ-8 šꜣms rʾ-16 bj.t ⸮sfḫ? gs
regions.translation: Another to expel hæmaturia (caused) by a god or a dead man in the belly of a man: juice of acacia 1 ro, juice of pistacia 1 ro, ḳ of pistacia 1 ro, ḏrt 4 ro, salt 1 ro, grapes 4 ro, the interior of wḏʿjt 1 ro, šš 4 ro, šmś 2 ro, honey 1/6 hin (?),
